base_prompt: Turkish alternative pop, intimate live studio band, instrumental only. Warm acoustic guitar, expressive piano, melodic electric bass, real drum kit, restrained clean electric guitar. Cohesive memorable recurring two-bar lead motif, human microtiming and touch, breathing room for a future singer. No EDM drop, no genre switch, no dense synth layers, no vocals or speech. Key B minor, 104 BPM, 4/4. Lead motif: A two-bar motif played on a warm, muted Telecaster with spring reverb. Bar 1 begins on an eighth-note pickup on scale degree 5 (F#4), ascending 5-6-7-1 (F#4-G4-A4-B4) across beats 1 and 2, settling on B4 on beat 3 with slight finger vibrato. Bar 2 descends stepwise 1-7-6-5-3-2 (B4-A4-G4-F#4-D4-C#4) in dotted eighths and sixteenths, resolving with a micro-bend down to the tonic (B3)..

timeline.name: intro
timeline.arrangement: Sparse, warm fingerpicked upright piano introducing the tonic Bm motif with subtle room reverb. A gentle octave acoustic guitar join on beat 3 of bar 2.

timeline.name: verse_1
timeline.arrangement: Warm upright piano continues. Subtle, damp rimshot pattern enters on beat 4 alongside a round, warm electric bass playing rooted quarter notes with melodic stepwise fills.

timeline.name: pre_1
timeline.arrangement: Rhythm swells with soft brushed snare press-rolls. Bass lines become more active, moving up to G and A. High octave piano chords swell slightly with ambient delay.

timeline.name: chorus_1
timeline.arrangement: Open strummed acoustic guitar enters on both channels. Full live snare on beats 2 and 4 with crisp hi-hat open-close pedal work. Clean electric guitar plays the signature two-bar melodic hook.

timeline.name: turnaround
timeline.arrangement: Drums drop to a single Kick-rim pattern. Piano repeats the opening motif twice while electric guitar lets its last note decay into spring reverb.

timeline.name: verse_2
timeline.arrangement: Drums maintain a subtle 4-on-the-floor kick with rim clicks. Bass locks tightly to the kick drum while executing subtle slide fills into the root tones.

timeline.name: pre_2
timeline.arrangement: Building dynamic energy. Snare switches from rim to light center hits. Crescendo on the crash cymbal leading straight into the chorus explosion.

timeline.name: chorus_2
timeline.arrangement: Full band arrangement with strummed acoustic guitars, driving bassline, active live snare, and prominent electric guitar hook doubling the vocal counter-melody.

timeline.name: bridge
timeline.arrangement: Strips back suddenly to dynamic minimalist texture. Lush harmonic color provided by Gmaj7 and F#7alt chords on organ/rhodes while bass plays solitary low notes.

timeline.name: final_chorus
timeline.arrangement: Maximum emotional energy without altering the indie-pop aesthetic. Added tambourine layer, wider acoustic panning, and expressive drum fills around the hook guitar.

timeline.name: outro
timeline.arrangement: Instruments peel away one by one. Acoustic guitar strums slow down, leaving only the piano playing the unresolved Bm chord as room noise fades.
